root_idea.summary: The root centers on sleep, especially sleep during the night.
root_idea.development: The basic sleep meaning extends to a sleep interval or light early-night sleep, a derived verb meaning to sleep, and a figurative description of a foolish person who is submissive to everyone. A specialized reported use denotes the setting of a star.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized Form I perfect citation form هَجَعَ rather than the supplied imperfect QAC lemma يَهْجَعُ.

senses.usage_conditions: In كانوا قليلاً من الليل ما يهجعون (51:17), the wording may describe their sleeping as occupying little of the night, or, through the use of قليلًا for near-negation, their scarcely sleeping or not sleeping.

other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form V derived verb meaning to sleep.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A sleep or sleep interval; specifically, a light sleep in the first part of the night.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun for an episode or period of sleep, with the supplied classical specialization to light early-night sleep.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A foolish person who is submissive or yielding to everyone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative characterization of a person, presented as an extension of the sleep-related root meaning.
A specialized reported use, marked in the evidence as tentative or assumed figurative usage.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Form V lexical meaning ‘to sleep’ is represented.
Light early-night sleep meaning is represented.

cautions: The Quranic occurrence is supplied in an imperfect plural surface form, while the public headword is normalized to the Form I perfect هَجَعَ.
